items.title: Cache kyun lagate hain: memory, disk aur network ki speed ka fark
items.one_idea: Memory, disk and network are different distances away from the CPU, so keeping a copy of data you need again and again in the nearest place (a cache) skips the slow trip.
items.spoken_hook: Interviewer ने पूछा: Cache लगाने से system fast क्यों होता है?
items.hook_formula: interviewer_asked: one complete 9-word question; first teaching line is the distance analogy, nothing between
